# Mad Lad Studios

> Free browser-based games for kids ages 2–6. No downloads, no ads tracking, no accounts required. All games run in-browser with HTML5/JavaScript.

## About

Mad Lad Studios creates safe, colorful, educational games for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2–6). Control support varies by game; some games require a keyboard. Every game is free to play at https://madladstudios.com.

## Games by Category

### 🏁 Racing Games (ages 3–6)
- [Drag Race Game](https://madladstudios.com/racetrack-game.html): Race to the finish line and stop accurately. Builds hand-eye coordination and timing.
- [Speed Drag Race](https://madladstudios.com/speed-drag-race-game.html): Choose a car and race down a drag strip. Teaches cause-and-effect and decision making.
- [Drag Race](https://madladstudios.com/drag-race-game.html): Tap to accelerate and race to the finish. Develops timing and motor skills.
- [Simple Drag Race](https://madladstudios.com/simple-drag-race-game.html): Simplified racing for younger toddlers. Introduces basic game interaction.
- [Rally Jump](https://madladstudios.com/rally-jump-game.html): Drive over ramps and land jumps. Builds anticipation and spatial reasoning.
- [Red Car Game](https://madladstudios.com/red-car-game.html): Dodge obstacles at speed. Develops reaction time and focus.
- [Motorcycle Game](https://madladstudios.com/motorcycle-game.html): Ride a motorcycle and avoid traffic. Builds attention and reflexes.
- [Jumping Car](https://madladstudios.com/jumping-car-game.html): Jump over obstacles in a car. Teaches timing and rhythm.
- [Police Chase](https://madladstudios.com/police-chase-game.html): Chase vehicles as a police car. Encourages role-play and spatial tracking.

### 🚒 Truck & Vehicle Games (ages 2–5)
- [Drive Fire Truck](https://madladstudios.com/drive-firetruck-game.html): Drive a fire truck through the city. Introduces community helpers and navigation.
- [Fire Fighter](https://madladstudios.com/firetruck-game.html): Spray water to extinguish fires. Teaches cause-and-effect and problem solving.
- [Delivery Truck](https://madladstudios.com/delivery-truck-game.html): Deliver packages around town. Builds route planning and sequencing skills.
- [Garbage Truck](https://madladstudios.com/garbage-truck-game.html): Collect trash in a garbage truck. Teaches environmental awareness and sequencing.
- [Car Wash](https://madladstudios.com/carwash-game.html): Drive through a car wash collecting bubbles. Develops tracking and anticipation.

### 🚂 Train Games (ages 2–5)
- [Train Game](https://madladstudios.com/train-game.html): Drive a train and collect cars. Teaches counting, sequencing, and track-switching.
- [Train Cleanup](https://madladstudios.com/train-cleanup-game.html): Clear debris from tracks with a locomotive. Builds problem-solving and navigation skills.

### 🐾 Animal Games (ages 2–5)
- [Crab Game](https://madladstudios.com/crab-game.html): Guide a crab to collect pearls and avoid sharks. Develops directional control and risk assessment.
- [Beetle Maze](https://madladstudios.com/beetle-maze-game.html): Navigate a beetle through a maze. Builds spatial reasoning, planning, and persistence.

### 🎓 Learning Games (ages 2–4)
- [Sorting Game](https://madladstudios.com/sorting-game.html): Drag vehicles and animals into correct categories. Teaches categorization, vocabulary, and cognitive grouping.
- [Bell Music Game](https://madladstudios.com/bell-music-game.html): Tap colorful bells to hear notes, then drag to reorder them into a musical scale. Teaches pitch recognition, sequencing, auditory discrimination, and fine motor skills.

### More Racing, Flying & Learning Games
- [Butterfly Match](https://madladstudios.com/butterfly-match-game.html): Match butterflies to flowers by color and shape.
- [Rally Race](https://madladstudios.com/rally-race-game.html): Choose a rally car and race across terrain stages.
- [Spelling Vehicle Rally](https://madladstudios.com/plane-spelling-rally-game.html): Choose a plane or truck and collect letters in order.
- [Sports Extra Racing](https://madladstudios.com/sports-extra-racing-game.html): Race a sports car around a winding circuit.
- [Parking Puzzle](https://madladstudios.com/parking-puzzle-game.html): Slide cars to clear an exit across twelve puzzles.
- [Race Car Builder](https://madladstudios.com/race-car-game.html): Choose a body, paint, engine, tires, and spoiler, then race and repair your car.
- [Tora! Tora! Tora! Airshow Flight](https://madladstudios.com/tora-airshow.html): Choose an aircraft and fly a 3D airshow sandbox.
- [Airplane Island Adventure](https://madladstudios.com/airplane-island-adventure-game.html): Drive to collect letters, unlock the hangar, and fly to island airports.
- [Ocean Airport](https://madladstudios.com/ocean-airport-game.html): Guide an airplane to a safe runway landing and unlock more aircraft.
- [3D Circuit Racing](https://madladstudios.com/circuit-racing-game.html): Choose a 3D vehicle and drive three laps around a circuit.
- [Rally Collect](https://madladstudios.com/rally-collect-game.html): Collect RALLY letters, sounds, and photos while driving through courses.

## Cognitive & Developmental Benefits

All games are designed with early childhood development in mind:

- **Fine Motor Skills**: Tapping, dragging, and swiping develop hand-eye coordination
- **Cause and Effect**: Every action produces a visible, rewarding response
- **Sequencing & Ordering**: Many games involve putting things in order (trains, musical notes, routes)
- **Categorization**: Sorting games teach grouping by shared attributes
- **Spatial Reasoning**: Mazes, racetracks, and navigation build spatial awareness
- **Auditory Development**: The bell music game trains pitch discrimination and musical patterns
- **Attention & Focus**: Avoiding obstacles and tracking moving objects builds sustained attention
- **Problem Solving**: Route planning, maze navigation, and fire-fighting require strategic thinking
- **Vocabulary & Language**: Games expose children to words like vehicles, animals, instruments
- **Role Play & Imagination**: Driving trucks, fighting fires, and police chases encourage imaginative play

## Technical Details

- All games are client-side HTML5/JavaScript — no server required
- Touch support varies; Tora Airshow, Airplane Island Adventure, and 3D Circuit Racing currently require keyboard controls.
- No user accounts or personal data collection
- Games use Canvas API or DOM-based rendering
- Audio generated via Web Audio API (no external audio files needed)
- Hosted on GitHub Pages at madladstudios.com
